name: Front selectable locker
_note: An open front diff the driver can lock: both front wheels turn together, so one in the air or on ice can't take all the drive. Locked, it fights the steering: for off road, slowly.

frontDifferential._note: type: 'open' (equal torque to both wheels, so the lighter one can spin up), 'locked' (both wheels at the same speed) or 'lsd' (clutch-type limited slip: it resists a speed difference with up to preload + lock × the torque going through it, N·m). lockable: the driver can lock it (a selectable locker). torqueSteer: on a driven front axle, how much of the car's torque steer gets through.
